controles.affirmation: La Commission europeenne a ouvert une procedure formelle en septembre 2025 sur la maintenance on-premise ; le 9 juillet 2026 elle a adopte une decision rendant les engagements juridiquement contraignants, a mettre en oeuvre sous trois mois.
controles.verbatim_source: In September 2025, the European Commission (EC) started formal proceedings concerning SAP's on-premise maintenance and support policies... On July 9, 2026, the EC adopted a decision which declared SAP's commitments legally binding, thereby concluding its competition investigation into certain aspects of SAP's on-premise maintenance and support practices. SAP is required to implement the commitments within a period of three months after the EC's decision. (Half-Year Report 2026, Competition Law Claims)

controles.affirmation: Aucune amende, et l'enquete ne concernait pas le cloud.
controles.verbatim_source: The investigation did not relate to or affect our cloud offerings. (Half-Year Report 2026)

controles.affirmation: Celonis poursuit SAP aux Etats-Unis (antitrust) ; le tribunal a laisse prosperer une partie des demandes en octobre 2025, a autorise le 25 juin 2026 l'ajout de revendications sur secrets d'affaires deposees en mai 2026 ; proces fixe au 13 septembre 2027.
controles.verbatim_source: While the US court initially dismissed the majority of Celonis' claims in June 2025, it allowed additional claims to proceed in October 2025... The trial is currently scheduled to begin on September 13, 2027. In May 2026, Celonis added trade secret claims to its US lawsuit... On June 25, 2026, the court allowed Celonis to add these claims. (Half-Year Report 2026)

controles.affirmation: Montants reclames environ 70 M$ (61 M EUR au 30 juin 2026).
controles.verbatim_source: In its US antitrust case, Celonis is currently seeking damages of around US$70 million (around EUR 61 million as at June 30, 2026).

controles.affirmation: Plainte pour concurrence deloyale a Munich, contentieux brevets US et Allemagne, dialogue en cours avec le Bundeskartellamt.
controles.verbatim_source: Celonis also filed a complaint against SAP in Germany (Munich), alleging unfair competition. In addition, both SAP and Celonis have initiated several patent cases in various courts in the United States (Eastern District of Texas and Delaware) and in Germany (Munich and Dusseldorf). Additionally, SAP is currently engaged in a constructive dialogue with the German Federal Cartel Office (FCO - Bundeskartellamt) regarding a complaint raised by Celonis.

controles.affirmation: Teradata : provision de 387 M EUR fin 2025, charge complementaire de 29 M EUR, reglement de 480 M$ (408 M EUR) paye en mars 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: A provision of EUR 387 million for a potential settlement amount and related legal fees had been recognized as at December 31, 2025. As a result of the settlement, an additional expense of EUR 29 million was recorded in the first quarter of 2026. SAP paid the full settlement amount of US$480 million (EUR 408 million) in March 2026.

controles.affirmation: SAP annonce elle-meme une acceleration du declin du support logiciel.
controles.verbatim_source: Constant currencies software support revenue decline rate to accelerate in the coming years as a consequence of an acceleration of customers transforming to the cloud. (Quarterly Statement Q2 2026, Outlook)

controles.affirmation: Goodwill 30 408 M EUR au 30/06/2026, soit 40% du total du bilan (75 609 M EUR) et 67% des capitaux propres (45 248 M EUR), en hausse de 1 394 M EUR en six mois.
controles.verbatim_source: Goodwill 30,408 / 29,014 ; Total assets 75,609 / 70,362 ; Total equity 45,248 / 45,073 (Consolidated Statements of Financial Position, Quarterly Statement Q2 2026). Ratios recalcules : 40,2% et 67,2% ; delta goodwill 1 394.

controles.affirmation: Croissance des revenus cloud a devises constantes de 24% au T2 2026 contre 28% au T2 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: Cloud revenue 6,281 / 5,130 ; +22 (actual) ; +24 (constant currencies). Comparatif T2 2025 : 28% cc. (Quarterly Statement Q2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle non-IFRS de 27,8% au T2 2026 contre 28,5% ; marge brute cloud non-IFRS 74,6% contre 75,2% ; support logiciel 2 439 M EUR (-8%) ; licences 131 M EUR (-32%).
controles.verbatim_source: Operating margin (in %) 27.8 / 28.5 (non-IFRS) ; Cloud gross margin (in %) 74.6 / 75.2 (non-IFRS) ; Software support revenue 2,439 / 2,642 / -8 ; Software licenses revenue 131 / 194 / -32.

controles.affirmation: Marge brute 89,2% sur licences et support au S1 2026 (5 155 M EUR de revenus, 559 M EUR de couts) contre 74,4% pour le cloud (12 244 / 3 130).
controles.verbatim_source: Cloud 12,244 ; Cost of cloud -3,130 ; Software licenses and support 5,155 ; Cost of software licenses and support -559 (Consolidated Income Statements, six mois 2026). Calculs : 89,16% et 74,44%.

controles.affirmation: CCB 2025 a 21,05 Mds EUR, +25% cc contre 29% en 2024, ralentissement plus prononce que prevu ; 2 600 M EUR de rachats au S1 2026 (16 280 097 actions a 161,16 EUR) pour un nombre moyen d'actions passant de 1 167 a 1 158 millions.
controles.verbatim_source: reached EUR 21.05 billion at actual currencies... an increase of 25% on a constant currency basis (2024: 29% at constant currencies). This represents a more pronounced slowdown in the growth rate than anticipated (20-F FY2025) ; As of June 30, 2026, SAP had repurchased 16,280,097 shares at an average price of EUR 161.16 resulting in a purchased volume of approximately EUR 2.6 billion ; For the first half of 2026 and 2025, the weighted average number of shares was 1,158 million... and 1,167 million.
